company_description: Entergy Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production and retail distribution of electricity in the United States. It generates, transmits, distributes, and sells electric power in portions of Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, and Texas, including the City of New Orleans. It also engages in the ownership of interests in non-nuclear power plants that sell electric power to wholesale customers, as well as provides decommissioning services to other nuclear power plant owners. It generates electricity through gas, nuclear, coal, hydro, and solar power sources. The company sells energy to retail power providers, utilities, electric power co-operatives, power trading organizations, and other power generation companies. The company's power plants have approximately 25,000 megawatts of electric generating capacity. It delivers electricity to 3.1 million utility customers in Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, and Texas. Entergy Corporation was founded in 1913 and is headquartered in New Orleans, Louisiana.

risks.title: Régulation des tarifs et remboursements imposés
risks.score_rationale: Coeur du modèle d'utility régulée, évocation directe des rate refunds imposables. Citation: "Rate refunds may also be required, subject to applicable law."
risks.summary: Les revenus d'Entergy dépendent des régulateurs de Louisiane et voisins : tarifs rabotés ou remboursements imposés frappent directement le résultat.

risks.title: Exploitation du parc nucléaire
risks.score_rationale: Section dédiée aux opérations nucléaires des filiales, enjeux de performance continue et d'arrêts. Citation: "Nuclear Operating, Shutdown, and Regulatory Risks (Entergy Corporation, Entergy Arkansas, Entergy Louisiana, and System Energy) Certain of the Utility"
risks.summary: Le parc nucléaire doit produire en continu : arrêts prolongés, coûts ou incidents renversent l'équation économique.

risks.title: Météo, climat et demande d'énergie
risks.score_rationale: Langage explicite sur les températures douces réduisant les revenus, milieu de section. Citation: "As a corollary, mild temperatures in either season tend to decrease energy usage and resulting revenues."
risks.summary: Températures douces = moins de chauffage et de climatisation ; ouragans du Golfe = coûts de reconstruction.

risks.title: Conjoncture économique de la zone desservie
risks.score_rationale: Langage conditionnel standard sur les ralentissements économiques régionaux. Citation: "Negative changes in any of these or other factors, particularly sustained economic downturns or sluggishness, have the potential to result in slower s"
risks.summary: Un ralentissement durable de l'économie du Golfe réduit la consommation industrielle et résidentielle.
